name: meadow-src-walls-a1
refs: Our approved meadow scene (project-owned): match its art style, colours, flat colour steps, scale and light exactly. Its cliff faces are the wall material to repeat.
The owner's target for cliffs (cleared): the quality and detail of the rock, moss and roots.
prompt: Make a tileset source sheet for cutting, in exactly the first reference's style, scale and light (top-down three-quarter view, light from the top left). On a plain flat light-green grass ground with nothing else on it, draw separate cliff sections spaced well apart: three long straight runs of a one-level grassy-topped rock cliff face (each about five times as wide as it is tall), every section different in its stones, cracks, moss and roots; two runs of a two-level cliff (twice as tall, one continuous rock wall); four short sections showing the cliff's left end and right end as rounded rock columns; two outer corners where the plateau's edge turns and the cliff wraps around it; two inner corners where a cliff face meets a plateau side going down. Grass and roots hang over every cliff top; each cliff casts a flat stepped shadow to the lower right. Flat colour steps, no soft gradients, strong dark outlines. No water, no stairs, no props, no characters, no text, no grid, no border, no UI.
